description: Save the authenticated user's review (fun score 1-100 + optional written body) for a game. Upserts on (game, user). The score is the same one kineticist_set_fun_score touches; submitting a review with score keeps both surfaces aligned. Acts on the API key owner's own library. Available on every tier, but agents that make many calls per task burn through a free-tier daily quota quickly. Email colin@kineticist.com for a higher ceiling.

body.description: Optional written review. Omit or empty string for score-only.

gameId.description: Game UUID. Accepts both the raw UUID and the 'gm_'-prefixed form that get_game_details returns (prefix stripped automatically).

name: kineticist_submit_review
title: Save your review
